subject: Heads-up: Ziggy stepped in tonight and guided the James / sandworm exploration directly
body: Ziggy asked me to tell you that he personally stepped in tonight (voice call and chat, about 00:04-00:17 ET 2026-10-14) to guide my work. Direction he gave: (1) Clean the James gun-removal derivative until it is gun-free and lock it as the reference BEFORE any variants are made; it will be saved as v002, and v001 stays. (2) Then 150 James exploration variants: no Falcon-tied ship; varied original ship designs; James can be a pilot; desert Lisan world; a hero shot of a large ship overhead with James in the cockpit and worms below; some variants with other characters; every image gets a preliminary match grade against the locked reference. (3) 100 sandworms in tiers he suggested as life stages: hatchling, adolescent, adult (male/female body types, color patterns per tier), elder, and the king worm, which is Lisan's own. The king worm needs a new, non-copyrighted name (not the name he mentioned on the call), and at least one shot has Lisan riding it with James in the scene. (4) The usual closing package afterwards: a Nova briefing, screenwriting material and storyboard tasks for Claude, and a full manifest. He mentioned putting the validator on it later, depending on how well the references land. Note: 45 James variants made from the old gun reference before this direction will be kept as a separate, uncounted early batch. This is not a production approval.
